extracted.intended_audience: investor relations professionals, corporate communications teams, CFOs and management teams responsible for IR
extracted.subtask_description: A practical guide for corporate IR teams on planning and executing investor relations activities that meet investor/analyst expectations, comply with regulation, and drive shareholder value. Covers strategy, communications, earnings calls, roadshows, presentation decks, and guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Meet investor and analyst expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: How do you meet the expectations of investors and analysts and stay on the right side of the law and myriad regulations?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Framed as a central challenge the guide addresses; implies responsiveness, transparency, and regulatory compliance when engaging investors and analysts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Investor relations best practices
rubrics_metrics.description: ICR’s Insider’s Guide to Investor Relations offers comprehensive insights on investor relations best practices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Broad umbrella covering routines, policies, and tactics deemed effective for IR; no specific items listed on page beyond being a major topic of the eBook.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developing a strategic IR plan
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied guidance: create a formal, strategic plan to guide IR activities; page lists this as a distinct subject area covered by the guide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communicating effectively with Wall Street
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers how to craft and deliver messages to investors, analysts, and sell-side/buy-side audiences; page does not provide specifics but identifies this as a core dimension.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conducting earnings calls
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses the practices and mechanics of running earnings calls—preparation, messaging, Q&A handling and compliance considerations are implied though not detailed on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Building an effective IR presentation deck
rubrics_metrics.description: Building an effective IR presentation deck
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focuses on design and content of investor-facing presentations (deck structure, key metrics, storytelling); page lists this as a covered topic without further examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conducting and maximizing the benefits of non-deal roadshows
rubrics_metrics.description: Conducting and maximizing the benefits of non-deal roadshows
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied criteria include planning itineraries, targeting investors, messaging consistency, and follow-up to extract maximum value from roadshows; page only enumerates the topic.

rubrics_metrics.name: Developing effective guidance
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refers to creating financial or operational guidance for the market that balances clarity, credibility, and regulatory constraints; listed as a guide topic without on-page details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Driving greater shareholder value through improved IR
rubrics_metrics.description: Drive greater value to your shareholders by improving your IR practices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frames the objective metric of IR success (shareholder value); implies evaluating IR by its impact on investor perceptions and ultimately shareholder valuation.
